utterances.text: You are talking about Brajkovici, which has nothing to do with Grahovcici. Brajkovici is far from Grahovcici, some 7 kilometres away from Grahovcici.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let me rephrase that question. After the 12th of June, 1993, until October 1994, you never returned to Grahovcici.

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: When there was a new attack on the 11th of June on Sarici I was heavily wounded and transferred to Nova Bila, to the hospital there. Some 10 or 12 days later I was transferred to Rama with the help of SFOR, and from there I was transferred to Split, and there I underwent surgery. And I didn't return to that area until the period you have just mentioned.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If I could ask the witness to mark Sarici village on the map that he has before him, Sarici being the reserve position that he has been mentioning in his testimony.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the counsel and witness make a pause between their answer and question.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you mark it by the next number in the subsequence?

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: On this map, I don't see Sarici. Sarici is a small village with only 20 houses. There is Han Bila, there is Guca Gora. So I can just approximately --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes, do it approximately.

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: Yes, approximately it would be here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you put a number next to it.

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: What number? Number 5? [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Defence will tender this map into evidence, and we have no further questions for this witness. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Has the Prosecution got an objection to tendering of this exhibit into evidence ?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Any objection? Madam Registrar, can you give me the number for this exhibit, the final number for this exhibit.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The exhibit number is DK2.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Microphone not activated] -- DK2. Therefore, we are talking about the same document maybe --

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Maybe this witness could sign the document and put a date on it.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Witness complies]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, then. Are there any -- is there any re-examination from the OTP, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Just a few questions, Mr. President. Re-examined by Mr. Mundis:

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Witness, can you tell the Trial Chamber, please, where is the area that you've mentioned as Bilici.

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: Bilici is in Grahovcici, in the vicinity of Strmac Hill.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So it would be correct, then, to say that Bilici is part of Grahovcici?

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you please tell the Trial Chamber where Nikolici is located.

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: Even closer to Strmac, some 50 metres as the crow flies.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And is Nikolici also part of Grahovcici?

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Witness, in response to a question asked by the Defence for Mr. Hadzihasanovic you said the following - I would like you to listen to your answer, and then I have a follow-on question for you - you were asked about being able to see houses burning or seeing the area of Bilici and Nikolici, and you said - and this is at lines 11 through 14 of today's LiveNote - you "just saw the soldiers leaving the houses. They were approaching the houses and immediately afterwards the house would start burning. They would then leave or move away from the house, approach another house, and carry on, continue." My question is, Witness, if you know: The soldiers would continue doing what or carry on doing what?

utterances.speaker: ZARKO JANDRIC
utterances.text: Once the house started burning, they would open fire on our positions or they would fire in the air. They would shout Allah-U-Ekber Tekbir and then they would continue on their way.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you, Witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The Prosecution has no further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Since the OTP has no further questions, the Chamber would like to thank you for coming to The Hague to testify before this Trial Chamber and we wish you a safe return home. I would kindly ask the usher to remove the headset from the witness's head and to escort him out of the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your, while we still have the witness, my learned friend mentioned a page and a line on the LiveNote. Can he please repeat where exactly he was reading from, because I'm afraid that maybe there is a misunderstanding in the way I was being quoted.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: It was the response of the witness at page 48, lines 14 -- or excuse me, lines 11 through 14 of today's LiveNote at page 48.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, just for the record, I would like to say that I never mentioned Bilici, Nikolici, or any other places that were quoted by my learned friend as having been mentioned by myself. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. President, to the extent that I indicated that it was Ms. Residovic who said that, I do stand corrected. The record reflects it was the witness who mentioned the two villages in question.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to object to both the question and the answer for this precise reason.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Would the Prosecutor like to withdraw this question, then? Because according to what the Defence has just said, these names were mentioned later on rather than at the beginning. Would the Prosecution like to clarify that, or maybe you would like to admit that your question has not been put in the proper manner. It seems that there has been some confusion. The Defence thought that the Prosecution wanted to mention a series of names, and the witness at the beginning of his testimony did not mention all of these places. I believe that this is the problem. Therefore, what about the solution to this problem? Another solution would be for the Prosecution to rephrase and put the question in a more precise manner. And the Trial Chamber will take into consideration that this has been disputed and therefore allows the OTP to rephrase their question, to ask the question again. And after that, I'm going to give the floor to the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. President, I don't think it's necessary to rephrase the question nor to withdraw it. The point simply was that the answer the witness gave in response to the question ended with the witness saying "approach another house and carry on, continue." The question was simply to elicit from the witness "carry on or continue doing what?" And the witness in fact, in response to the question on redirect examination answered that question. The sole reason for putting that question to the witness in redirect was, therefore, accomplished. And to the extent that I may have alluded to or did allude to a question or what Ms. Residovic said, I do apologise for that. It was -- it was completely inadvertent. But again, the point was to simply clarify from the witness "continue or carry on doing what?" And in fact, he has answered that question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to ask the Defence whether they are satisfied with the Prosecutor's answer. The Prosecutor has limited his question to the fact that houses were torched and the Prosecution wanted to know what the troops did later on. That was the sense of the question. Therefore, the Prosecution withdraws those parts for which the Defence thought they were not appropriate. Once again, I would like to thank the witness once again, and I would like to wish him a safe return home. The usher is going to escort you out of the courtroom. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, then. It is 12 past 5.00. We have to make another break. We shall resume at half past 5.00. We can call the next witness now, but if we do that we have to go into closed session, because the protective measures have been granted to this witness. Can I please ask the Registrar, Madam Registrar, whether we can indeed go into closed session, whether the closed session conditions have been set in place.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 16th day of December, 2003, at 9.00 a.m.
